simple.meaning: נֹפֶת (nôpheth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a dripping i.e. of honey (from the comb).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נֹפֶת (H5317) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 19:11, with occurrences in Psalms, Proverbs, Song of Solomon.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֹפֶת (H5317) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נֹפֶת (H5317) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נֹפֶת (nôpheth) / H5317 is traced through Psalms 19:11, Proverbs 5:3, Proverbs 24:13, Proverbs 27:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a dripping i.e. of honey (from the comb)
definitions.full: H5317. nopheth נֹ֫פֶת noun masculine Prov 24:13 flowing honey, honey from the comb (Phoenician נפת CIS i.166, 8b ); — ׳נ absolute 5:3 3 t., construct Psa 19:11 ; — sweet Prov 24:13 (|| דְּבַשׁ ), compare 27:7 ; figurative of sweet words 5:3 , and perhaps Song 4:11 (Bu of kisses; || חָלָב דְּבַשׁ, ); in full צוּפִים ׳נ Psa 19:11 honey of (the) combs (compare with י ׳מִשְׁפְטֵי ; || דְּבַשׁ ). נֶפְתּוֺחַ see פתח . נַפְתָּלִי נַמְּתּוּלִים, see פתל .
definitions.rootNote: from 5130 in the sense of shaking to pieces;

occurrences.englishText: Moreover your servant is warned by them.
